title: Selva tier pricing — single source of truth
description: Canonical pricing data for Selva. Anything that reads tier numbers — billing_tiers.py, the office-ui bundle page, Dhanam catalog seeders — should fetch from this file (Python) or import via JSON at build time (TS). Hardcoding numbers anywhere else trips the CI drift gate.

$schema.description: Pointer to this schema file. Editors that follow $schema get autocomplete + validation.

generated_from.description: Path to the upstream Tulana decision doc this data was derived from. MUST be a real file in the internal-devops/decisions/ tree.

last_updated.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when this file was last edited. Bumped manually with every value change.

currency_assumption_mxn_per_usd.description: FX rate baked into MXN tier values. Per Tulana v0.1: 17.0. Update when Tulana v0.2 ships dynamic FX.

iva_included.description: Whether MXN values include 16% IVA. Per Tulana v0.1: true.

_comment_for_humans.description: Free-text guidance for editors. Ignored by code; surfaced in code review.

default_tier.description: Tier slug used when an org has no Dhanam subscription. MUST be a key in `tiers`.

stripe_price_id_env_key.description: Env var name that holds the Stripe price ID for this tier. The actual price ID is per-environment and lives in the secret store.
